metadata.title: COBO L1 - Windows 11 Deployment & Hardening Profile

props.name: implements-sspp
props.remarks: This component implements the COBO L1 Managed Endpoint SSPP for Windows 11.

metadata.remarks: This component defines the authoritative Windows 11 deployment, configuration, and hardening implementation for COBO L1 managed endpoints. It aligns the COBO L1 SSPP to the CIS Windows 11 Benchmark while documenting required controls, deviations, and enforcement expectations.

components.title: Account and Authentication Security
components.description: Account, authentication, and credential protection controls for Windows 11 endpoints.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Password length, history, and complexity enforced per institutional policy.
Guest and unused local accounts disabled.
Strong authentication enforced through centralized identity and device policy.

components.title: Privilege and Role Enforcement
components.description: Restriction of administrative privileges on COBO L1 endpoints.

implemented-requirements.remarks: No standing local administrator rights for standard users.
Least privilege enforced on endpoint operating system.

components.title: Malware and Threat Protection
components.description: Runtime malware detection, behavioral analysis, and containment.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Baseline Attack Surface Reduction rules enforced.
Local containment actions supported for endpoint threats.

components.title: Logging and Audit
components.description: Endpoint logging, auditing, and telemetry forwarding.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Security audit policies enabled per institutional baseline.
Endpoint audit events generated and forwarded centrally.

components.title: Documented CIS Deviations
components.description: Explicitly approved deviations from CIS recommendations.
components.remarks: CIS Level 1 controls are adopted selectively. Any excluded control MUST be documented with rationale, mitigation, and approval.
